meta.name: github
meta.description: Interact with GitHub using the `gh` CLI. Use `gh issue`, `gh pr`, `gh run`, and `gh api` for issues, PRs, CI runs, and advanced queries. Use when the user asks about GitHub issues, pull requests, workflows, or wants to interact with GitHub repositories from the command line — including tasks like check CI status, create PR, list issues, or query the GitHub API.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常用命令行操作 GitHub 仓库和 CI。
copy.tagline_en: Manage GitHub repos, issues, and CI from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage GitHub repos and CI from the terminal.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 gh 命令行工具帮你查看 GitHub 仓库的 Issue、PR、CI 运行状态，还能执行高级 API 查询。
howto.when: 当你询问 GitHub 上的 Issue、PR、工作流状态，或要求执行 gh 命令（如检查 CI、创建 PR、列出 Issue）时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个 PR 的 CI 状态
列出最近 10 次工作流运行
查看这个 PR 的标题和状态
say.note: Claude 会使用 gh api 查询 PR 的详细信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the gh CLI to interact with GitHub repositories: check issues, pull requests, CI runs, and perform advanced API queries.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about GitHub issues, pull requests, workflows, or want to execute gh commands such as checking CI status, creating PRs, or listing issues.

say_en.text: Check the CI status of this PR
say_en.note: Claude will run gh pr checks to view PR check results.
Claude will run gh run list to list recent CI runs.

say_en.text: Show the title and state of this PR
say_en.note: Claude will use gh api to query PR details.
